verdict.rationale: Mirrors is a developer tool for production AI agents, not an agent itself, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only an npm SDK, capture hooks, and framework integrations. Nothing documents an official MCP server or endpoint, and the mention that a coding agent can write corrections does not establish one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
